estimates.assumptions: 150g butter (all used in batter + 25g for brushing tins; full amount counted as consumed in final cakes)
175g plain white flour (full amount used in batter)
125g caster sugar (full amount used in batter)
3 large eggs (~50g edible portion each; full amount used in batter)
1 tsp (~4g) baking powder (full amount used; modest estimate)
2 tsp (~6g) cocoa powder (full amount used in marble batter)
3 tbsp (~45ml) milk (full amount used to dissolve cocoa)
1 tbsp (~8g) icing sugar (full dusting amount for finished cakes)
